context: Aoi and Kenji compare childhood photos and reminisce gently.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: この写真、子供の頃の私。
lines.en: This photo—it's me when I was little.
lines.style: Soft opening. Nostalgic warmth in the voice. Slight pause before 'it's me'—a small vulnerability showing old versions of yourself. Gentle, unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Genuine surprise and warmth. Kansai lilt on 'adorable'—affectionate, not performative. Leaning in to look. The ease of a man who means what he says.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お母さん、よく着せてくれてた。
lines.en: My mom used to dress me up so carefully.
lines.style: Soft, remembering voice. Slight smile underneath. Speaking to the photo more than to him. Affection for her mother layered beneath the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Ah, brings back memories—let me see.
lines.style: Kansai warmth. Genuine curiosity, not just politeness. Reaches toward the photo naturally. Interested in what she's showing him, not just being kind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Small moment of pride in the memory. Quiet delight. Handing him the photo. Voice settles into the fondness of looking back together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Those memories really are precious, aren't they.
lines.style: Kansai reflection. Unhurried, like he's realizing it as he speaks. Genuine weight to 'precious'—not sentimental, but true. Warmth without rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Simple, strong word choice. She's not overstating—just affirming what matters. Soft exhale at the end, like peace.
